name: Showcase
description: The test world: a fully fitted Väktare near the Starogród Belt whose scenario checkpoints exercise every Entieve feature. Driven headlessly by tests/showcase_test.go.

scenario.name: Fitting: one module of every kind
scenario.detail: Start fit fills the Väktare's whole 3/3/2 rack: 3 high (mod-autocannon-s, mod-mining-laser, mod-rocket-pod), 3 mid (mod-afterburner, mod-shield-boost, mod-stasis-web), 2 low (mod-armor-rep, mod-cap-recharger). Observe in the Fitting window or the sim Fitting store: High/Mid/Low hold 3/3/2 ModuleIDs; the remaining kinds (shield-extender, armor-plate, resist-coat, cap-booster, warp-scram) are exercised via module-fit/module-unfit below.

scenario.name: Module activation and cycles
scenario.detail: CmdActivate(0) fires the small autocannon: EvtModuleActive is emitted, the module runtime shows a 3 s cycle, CmdDeactivate stops it. Repeat for F1-F8 mapped high modules.

scenario.name: Ammo consumption per shot
scenario.detail: With 12 shells of each small shell type in cargo, each shot consumes exactly one: stacks run down in cargo order and the gun finally reports 'no charges'.

scenario.name: Dry gun refuses to fire
scenario.detail: Fire a gun with no matching shell left in cargo: exactly one 'no charges' warning per dry cycle, then the module deactivates (the scripted late-game activation on the respawned Scuttler demonstrates it).

scenario.name: Turret hit chance
scenario.detail: Lock a belt rat (CmdLock) at optimal and fire: combat log hit lines show the 0.01-0.99 damage multiplier; flying transverse lowers the hit chance via the tracking formula.

scenario.name: Wrecking shot
scenario.detail: When the hit roll lands below 0.01 the shot is a wrecking x3 hit: the combat log line shows triple damage. Deterministic per seed - rerun the same seed to reproduce it.

scenario.name: Four damage types
scenario.detail: The gun consumes all four small shell profiles in cargo order - ammo-emp-s (EM), ammo-fusion-s (explosive), ammo-ap-s (kinetic), ammo-plutonium-s (thermal): each volley carries its shell's damage mix into the damage log.

scenario.name: Resists reduce damage
scenario.detail: Compare the raw volley against applied damage in the hit log: each hull's resists cut the penetrating damage below the raw volley (e.g. the marauder's resist coat adds +0.15 to every type).

scenario.name: Capacitor drain
scenario.detail: Active modules cost GJ (projectile guns draw none): the HUD capacitor bar drops 40 GJ per shield-boost cycle and 25 GJ per afterburner cycle (sim Capacitor.Current).

scenario.name: Capacitor recharge curve
scenario.detail: Deactivate everything: the cap refills on the EVE curve with peak rate near 25% capacity (dC/dt = 2.5*C/tau*sqrt(f)*(1-sqrt(f))). The passive mod-cap-recharger shortens the tau.

scenario.name: Cap booster instant GJ
scenario.detail: Drain the cap, CmdUnfitModule a mid module, CmdFitModule mod-cap-booster in its place and activate: GJ lands at once (Boost.CapRestore) and one charge-cap-cell is consumed from cargo.

scenario.name: Shield boosting
scenario.detail: Take shield damage, activate mod-shield-boost: the HUD shield arc climbs 60 HP every 4 s while the capacitor lasts (EvtModuleActive cycles in the log).

scenario.name: Armor repair
scenario.detail: Let armor take damage past the shield, activate mod-armor-rep: +55 HP per 5 s cycle, watch the HUD armor ring recover.

scenario.name: Afterburner speed boost
scenario.detail: CmdActivate the afterburner: velocity jumps to 1.75x MaxSpeed (385 -> ~674 m/s), the HUD speed readout rises and cap drains 25 GJ / 10 s.

scenario.name: Stasis web slows target
scenario.detail: Lock a rat, activate mod-stasis-web within range: its speed drops by web_strength (0.45) and the log notes the web.

scenario.name: Warp scramble blocks escape
scenario.detail: npc-rat-marauder fits mod-warp-scram: once it locks you it activates the scrambler (log: 'Warp Scrambler activated on Väktare'), blocking and cancelling warp starts for scram_duration per cycle.

scenario.name: Targeting lock and unlock
scenario.detail: Tab/CmdLock starts lock progress from scan_resolution vs target sig radius; EvtTargetLocked fires on completion, CmdUnlock drops the lock. Max 4 concurrent locks (hull max_targets).

scenario.name: Warp travel
scenario.detail: CmdWarpTo a distant celestial: EvtWarp phases run align -> warp -> land, arriving within 2500 m of the target; the HUD shows warp drive active.

scenario.name: Approach
scenario.detail: CmdApproach a bracket: the ship turns toward it and accelerates to MaxSpeed; Overview distance shrinks monotonically.

scenario.name: Orbit
scenario.detail: CmdOrbit(target, range): the ship holds a circle - Overview distance oscillates around the set range while facing stays tangent.

scenario.name: Manual piloting
scenario.detail: CmdManualVel(dir, speedFrac) steers by raw heading and throttle: velocity vector follows dir at MaxSpeed x speedFrac; CmdStop brings the ship to rest.

scenario.name: NPC aggro
scenario.detail: Approach a Starogród belt rat within its aggro_range (20000 m): its bracket turns hostile red and it breaks orbit to come at you - EvtLog aggro line.

scenario.name: NPC flee
scenario.detail: Drive a Scuttler below flee_threshold (0.15 structure): it stops fighting and burns off - the flee state and its 'retreats and escapes' log line. The Hierarch's threshold is 0: it never runs.

scenario.name: NPC death
scenario.detail: Push a rat's structure to 0: EvDestroyed fires, the ship is replaced by a wreck carrying its rolled loot table.

scenario.name: Bounty payout
scenario.detail: On NPC death the bounty lands in the wallet: scuttler 7,500 € / marauder 65,000 € / hierarch 250,000 € - watch the wallet delta in EvtLog.

scenario.name: Wreck looting
scenario.detail: CmdLoot(wreck, item) transfers stacks into cargo: EvtLooted names each item, the wreck's remaining loot shrinks to empty.

scenario.name: Mining cycle
scenario.detail: Lock an asteroid in cel-solace-belt, CmdMine(asteroid, index of mod-mining-laser): every 30 s cycle moves 40 m³ - EvtLog cycle line, cargo/ore-hold total rises.

scenario.name: Asteroid depletion
scenario.detail: Keep mining one rock: its Remaining volume (Asteroid component) drains to 0, the bracket empties/disappears, and further cycles log 'asteroid depleted'.

scenario.name: Ore hold vs cargo
scenario.detail: On the Väktare (ore_hold 0) mined ore lands in cargo (400 m³); on ship-barge the same ore fills the dedicated 16,500 m³ ore hold instead - compare the Inventory window's two tabs.

scenario.name: Cargo transfer
scenario.detail: CmdTransfer (script action 'transfer') moves stacks between the cargo hold, ore hold and station hangar while docked; loot and market sales move stacks too - totals stay conserved.

scenario.name: Gate jump
scenario.detail: CmdJump(cel-gate-penumbra): EvtJumped, then LoadSystem(sys-penumbra) swaps grid content; jumping back via cel-gate-solace proves the reciprocal gates both ways.

scenario.name: Docking
scenario.detail: CmdDock(cel-haven-rest) within docking range: EvtDocked fires, the ship leaves the grid (Docked marker) and the station services scene opens.

scenario.name: Undocking
scenario.detail: CmdUndock: EvtUndocked, the ship reappears on the grid at the station's position with full state preserved.

scenario.name: Station repair
scenario.detail: Damage the ship, dock at Jernborg (repair service), CmdRepair: shield/armor/structure snap back to hull maximum for a fee deducted from the wallet.

scenario.name: Market buy
scenario.detail: CmdBuy for a hull order (ship-sloop, cast to ItemID) or a module order (mod-artillery-s): EvtMarket fires, wallet decreases by price x qty, the item appears in station inventory.

scenario.name: Market sell
scenario.detail: CmdSell(loot-alloy-scrap, qty) at Jernborg: EvtMarket, wallet increases by the order price, the station order qty is unchanged (it is a buy-side listing).

scenario.name: Refining ore
scenario.detail: Dock where refine service exists, CmdRefine(ore-sterngrit, 100): one whole batch yields 45 min-ferrite (0.45/unit x 100), EvLog confirms.

scenario.name: Ship assembly
scenario.detail: Buy the ship-hauler hull order at the market, CmdAssemble(ship-hauler): the hull is assembled into your hangar and can be swapped into.

scenario.name: Module fitting
scenario.detail: Free a mid slot (CmdUnfitModule), then CmdFitModule(mod-cap-booster, mid, index): the Fitting window shows the new module and its stats apply (slot class must match).

scenario.name: Module un-fitting
scenario.detail: CmdUnfitModule removes a module back to inventory: the slot empties and its passive/active contributions vanish - HUD stats (e.g. tau with cap-recharger) change back.

scenario.name: NPC respawn timers
scenario.detail: Clear a spawn (Starogród belt 90 s, Kuźnica belt 120 s; anomaly cel-penumbra-den 300 s): after respawn_sec the group is back - the log reports the respawn.

scenario.name: Save and restore
scenario.detail: Sim.Snapshot() produces a Save; Sim.Restore(s) into a fresh sim reproduces wallet, cargo, fit, position and module states exactly - Snapshot() of both must match field-for-field.

scenario.name: Determinism
scenario.detail: Two sims built from the same content, world and seed given the same command sequence report equal Sim.Hash() at every step, including after a Snapshot/Restore round-trip.

scenario.name: Patrolling rats
scenario.detail: Idle NPCs drift on a slow deterministic patrol around their spawn anchor instead of sitting still: watch a belt rat circle its home while you keep your distance.

scenario.name: Sensor visibility
scenario.detail: Ships, asteroids and wrecks only appear on the overview within SensorRange (250 km). System landmarks are always listed, but distant rocks and rats stay hidden until you approach; the Scanner window shows anonymous long-range contacts.

scenario.name: Ammo selection
scenario.detail: CmdSetAmmo (script action 'setammo', right-click a weapon slot in game) sets a weapon's preferred shell: the gun consumes that exact item first and falls back to other shells of its calibre.

scenario.name: Warp to within
scenario.detail: CmdWarpTo with Range > 0 lands that far short of the target (0 = on top): warp in at 50 km from a station and close the last gap yourself.

scenario.name: Contracts and standing loop
scenario.detail: CmdAcceptMission (script action 'accept-mission') takes contract-solace-cleanup-1 off the Jernborg board: EvMission 'accepted' on acceptance, 'progress' when the belt Scuttler dies (kills count by rat class), 'ready' when the objective is met, and 'completed' auto-claimed when the player docks at the offering station again — wallet +40,000 € and Player.Standing +0.10 land in the same tick. Refused commands (not docked / wrong board / insufficient standing / unknown id) report EvMission phase 'refused'.

scenario.name: NPC traffic delivery and market drift
scenario.detail: Convoy haulers spawn on zone-scaled schedules (content/data/traffic/), warp the leg through the align/cruise/decel profile, and deliver at stations: EvTraffic phase 'delivered' posts the sourced stock as supply on the destination's order book (EvMarket 'price falls to ...'). The delivered good ends the run priced below its base.

scenario.name: Ambush on NPC traffic
scenario.detail: Every convoy tunnel entry in the Fringe or Unincorporated rolls the per-leg ambush chance (1-σ)/3 — 1-in-6 in Kuźnica: on a hit, 1-3 'Ambusher' raiders spawn mid-leg (EvTraffic phase 'attacked', System sys-penumbra), the hauler is dragged out of warp and burns away for 20 s before attempting its warp-out; scramblers pin it, patrols respond after 15 s. Outcomes: destroyed (lootable cargo wreck carrying the shipment; the destination gets nothing), escaped, or saved.

scenario.name: Charter patrol response
scenario.detail: The ambushed Kuźnica convoy calls for its patrol wing: EvTraffic phase 'patrol-response' (System sys-penumbra) dispatches a floor(3σ) wing from the patrol anchor, the patrol warps to the incident through the normal warp profile, locks the raiders with the real turret pipeline — and the pressure lets the convoy warp clear (EvTraffic phase 'escaped'). Charter space responds immediately with 3 ships, the Fringe after 15 s with 1, Unincorporated never.
